answer.text: The manual recommends shifting down from 3rd to 2nd gear at 25 km/h.

policy.text: Fully depress the clutch lever before any gear shift.
During acceleration or deceleration, disengage the clutch completely, shift the gear, then engage the clutch gradually (not too slowly).

watchouts.text: If acceleration is very high and the clutch lever is released abruptly, the motorcycle can move suddenly, causing loss of control, an accident, injury or death, and damage to the motorcycle.
If the clutch lever is released abruptly with insufficient throttle opening, the motorcycle will have a rough start and the engine will stall.

watchout_review.reason: Abrupt clutch release during a shift with insufficient throttle causes a rough start and stalling; one watchout cites it.
Abrupt clutch release at high acceleration can make the motorcycle move suddenly; one watchout cites it.
